correctness.rationale: Verified the uniform S^3 Haar factorization into independent W~Beta(1,1), U~Unif[0,pi/p], V~Unif[0,pi/q]. Conditioning gives exact W-interval, with no clipping error. The minimax over W occurs at balance and U,V at their angular endpoints; precisely pq deepest directions. Near the corner the positive-part tent has slope coefficients A=2c^2 sin(pi/p)/a^3 and B=2c^2 sin(pi/q)/b^3, integral (2/c)^3/(6AB)*epsilon^3; O(epsilon^4) follows Lipschitz positive part and bounded support. Independent (4,4) tangent 3-simplex yields C=512/(3pi^2); independent numerics recovered (4,5) c=0.5324073960 and C=25.0913881588. No finite computation substitutes for the uniform all-pair proof.
